_comment: Deletions and renames of guides under skills/, recorded so that scripts/check-sync-integrity.py --strict-metadata accepts them and so that a consumer holding an old slug can find the replacement. Every entry is reviewed by a human in the pull request that adds it. from/to are repository paths (to is null for a deletion); slug is the identifier that disappeared and replacement the one to use instead.

migrations.reason: Roadmap item 13: US-state guides moved to the us-<code>- namespace so a state slug can never collide with a country slug; the alias country folders were merged into their real ones; the international/us guides joined skills/federal; and 60 duplicate guides (orchestrator copies of state guides, the ny-nyc copy, the full-name state files that had a code-prefixed sibling, the same-slug pairs, 24 code-prefixed VAT/GST twins) were deleted in favour of the reviewed, versioned or newer copy.

Roadmap item 15: every guide the index counts is packaged and served. The build's redirect-stub heuristic is gone, so the one real stub (Kenya's ke-vat-return, which said 'see kenya-vat.md') is deleted; and the EU VAT base takes the slug eu-vat-directive, which every EU VAT guide names as its companion and which the shared file has always been called, in place of its older, shorter twin.

entries.note: redirect stub ('This skill has been consolidated. See kenya-vat.md'); the build never packaged it
older, shorter twin of eu-vat-base.md (its H1 was 'eu-vat-base'); the slug now belongs to the base, which was renamed onto this path
renamed to the slug the EU VAT guides name and packages/_shared/eu-vat-directive.md already carried; content unchanged
